query:

  CASE WHEN accessToken IS NOT NULL AND accessToken != '' THEN 'CONFIGURADO' ELSE 'NO CONFIGURADO' END as accessToken_status,
  CASE WHEN appSecret IS NOT NULL AND appSecret != '' THEN 'CONFIGURADO' ELSE 'NO CONFIGURADO' END as appSecret_status,
  createdAt 
FROM meta_ads_credentials;
